description: Java class implementing an authentication provider that verifies username/password credentials using Hono's Credentials API, including credential extraction and validation logic.

classes.name: UsernamePasswordAuthProvider
classes.description: A final class that extends CredentialsApiAuthProvider to authenticate devices using username and password credentials via Hono's Credentials API.

methods.name: UsernamePasswordAuthProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with dependencies, including a default password encoder.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Extracts username and password from JSON auth info to create UsernamePasswordCredentials, returns null if info is invalid.

methods.name: doValidateCredentials
methods.description: Validates credentials asynchronously by comparing provided password with stored secrets, executing on Vert.x context.
